headline: Elanco Animal Health Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Elanco Animal Health (NYSE:ELAN) reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.368 billion, up 10% on a reported basis and 8% organically in constant currency, as demand for new pet-health products and strength in U.S. farm animal operations supported growth.
